3560.title: ACP write completion returns a null payload
3560.rootCauseOneLine: The filesystem handler persists and emits the change before returning null, which an object-only consumer rejects.
3560.proposedFix: Validate the ACP response contract and return its required object, with a response-shape regression test.
3560.caveats: Live Devin and upstream schema unverified; local pnpm launcher prevented normal build. Public protocol changes are excluded from the simple-fix rule.
